# SCORES — M2.7 battery 2

Scored on 2026-11-12 by five independent judge agents (Claude Opus 5.5) working from [`harness/JUDGE.md`](./harness/JUDGE.md). Each judge viewed the side-by-side tiles (reference on the left, AI rebuild on the right) for desktop 1440 and iPhone 15, read the builder's code and journal, and checked every `webkit` cause in the package source. The raw scores, notes and causes for all 66 pages are in [`scores.json`](./scores.json); the published comparison pages are linked from the [README](./README.md).

**Scale (fidelity 0–5, the same as run 1).** 5 = indistinguishable except for harness or data noise · 4 = same regions and components, with small component or copy deviations · 3 = same skeleton, but visible content or component substitutions · 2 = several regions missing or wrong · 1 = barely related. Half points are allowed. The page score is the mean of desktop and iPhone. Font fallback (Rubik does not load in this harness), frozen carousel or marquee offsets and timestamps were not deducted.

Site pages are dark only (as azion.com); console screens are light only (as the design sample). The **Job** column names the builder; its journal is in [`journals/`](./journals/).

The visible quote (Axur instead of GFG) and the Login button are not deducted. |

## Reading the numbers

- **Console beats site (4.29 vs 3.92).** The console references are the design sample, whose screens were built from the same WebKit blocks the builders copied (`webkit search` found the right block on the first try for most screens), so console fidelity measures block discovery more than composition. The two best pages are console screens (`console-home-empty`, `console-bucket-browser`, 4.75).
- **Desktop beats iPhone (4.14 vs 3.93).** On the console the gap is 0.33: `SettingRow` stacks where the reference keeps two columns (three pages at iPhone 3.5), the pager collapses to "‹ 1 ›", and the collapsed `SearchTrigger` is a 44 px square beside 32 px icon buttons on every console screen. On the site the gap is 0.15, mostly the Login button in the phone bar of `SiteNav` and the `SiteFooter` mobile bottom bar.
- **The site loses its points on media, not structure.** Every site page kept the reference's band order. The products and solutions groups (3.77 and 3.75) score lowest because their media cells show near-miss registry illustrations instead of the live diagrams and console captures, because `MediaSplitStack` cannot take a diagram, and because no section renders the titled card carousel. The two pages at 3 (`site-product-object-storage`, `site-product-data-stream`) add builder misses on top (single-quote wall, form fragments instead of the shipped diagram). See [FINDINGS.md](./FINDINGS.md).
- **No page is missing and none scores below 3.** All 18 builders finished; `DONE.md` marks a few pages *partial* for one approximated band (card carousel, G2 badges).
- Per builder, the page means range from 3.33 (S2c, three product pages) to 4.38 (C2c, two console screens).

## Run 1, for context

Run 1 (same day, [`../run-1/SCORES.md`](../run-1/SCORES.md)) had **16 pages** built by three agents: 4 site, 4 docs, 4 console and 4 demo pages, light and dark, mobile at 390 px. Battery 2 has 66 pages, 18 builders, one theme per surface, and iPhone 15 at 393 px; the judges and the builders differ too. Treat the comparison as context, not as a trend.

Some run-1 owner fixes are visible here: contact's support grid is now an even 2×2 (`CardGrid layout="balanced"`), every header carries a `SearchTrigger`, and no judge reported the extra band under the footer. The overall mean did not move because battery 2 adds 42 site and 16 console pages that run 1 never tried, most of them product and solution pages with art WebKit does not ship.
